605:t_008:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You seem to have noticed. As expected of the $$ニュータイプ$$s entrusted with humanity's future.」

605:t_008:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's the $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

605:t_008:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$$クロノ$$ is trying to annihilate that colony to erase $$ラプラスの箱$$ and $$サイアム・ビスト$$, the key to the truth beyond it.」

605:t_008:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It seems the preparations are complete.」

605:t_008:10.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So that's what you meant when you said there was no time...!」

605:t_009:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「What are you going to do, $$バナージ$$!?」

605:t_009:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm going to put up a psycho-field in front of $$メガラニカ$$!」

605:t_009:3.en:
$$レイアム$$
「You mean to block the $$コロニーレーザー$$!」

605:t_009:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can hear me too, $$オードリー$$, right? Evacuate right now with the people there!」

605:t_009:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「My speech is over. But this signifies a new beginning.」

605:t_009:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have a duty to see for myself what it is.」

605:t_009:11.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Show me. ...And come back without fail. I will not allow you to break a promise.」

605:t_009:12.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That's right, you'd better come back!」

605:t_009:13.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Don't die, $$バナージ$$! I've had enough of people dying!」

605:t_009:14.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Our fight isn't over yet! We still have to graduate from high school!」

605:t_010:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even this $$バンシィ$$ is a psycho-machine. It'll be of some use.」

605:t_010:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... and what lies at the bottom of it... It isn't just your family's problem.」

605:t_010:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's a problem for all of us... no, for everyone in the world.」

605:t_011:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If the $$ユニコーン$$ is a machine that can turn people's will into power, then use our feelings too.」

605:t_011:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm just an ordinary guy, so I may not be much help, but I'm better than nothing, right!」

605:t_011:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$ホワイトドール$$'s $$月光蝶$$ can help deflect beams too!」

605:t_011:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Units with fields, move to the front! All other units, fall back to the rear!」

605:t_011:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Everyone wants to know. What lies beyond this.」

605:t_011:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「To do that, we can't let $$メガラニカ$$ go down.」

605:t_011:7.en:
$$シン$$
「So let's do it. Let's combine the strength of $c.」

605:t_011:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「I believe it. That there is a future beyond this.」

605:t_011:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So this is... what $$ガンダム$$ has led us to... the power to believe in hope and move on toward the future...」

605:t_011:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「My ancestor... $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ was part of it too. They held a faint hope for the distant future and sent it off with every prayer they could.」

605:t_011:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「Whether we make it a curse or a possibility, that's... Well. It doesn't hurt to know it. That we were born blessed.」

605:t_011:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If he had just said so from the start... it would have been easier to understand...」

605:t_011:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「A father always leaves out one word... and the child has to make up for it on their own.」

605:t_011:14.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What a misfortune... isn't it.」

605:t_012:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Do you mean to die with me out of despair, $n?」

605:t_012:1.en:
$n
「That's not it! I'm going to save you!」

605:t_012:3.en:
$n
「I refuse to believe that Miss $$スズネ$$ has vanished from inside you! Never!」

605:t_012:4.en:
$n
「So I won't let you do whatever you want with Miss $$スズネ$$'s body! I won't accept you dying on your own!」

605:t_012:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Are you idiots...? Running away might actually save you, you know.」

605:t_012:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「You can't move forward if you keep running away!」

605:t_012:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Here lies what was left by people who believed in the future and entrusted it to later generations!」

605:t_012:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Only by protecting that can we protect our own future too.」

605:t_012:9.en:
$n
「You're coming along too, $$アムブリエル$$! For what we have to protect!」

605:t_012:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...Do as you like...」

605:t_012:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「GN Fields to full! All units, set your fields to maximum output too!!」

605:t_012:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Combine our strength, $$ユニコーン$$!!」

605:t_013:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「$$メガラニカ$$ and $c are both safe!」

605:t_013:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「We did it, all of us!」

605:t_013:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$ has been opened... Let's rest a little, $$バナージ$$.」

605:t_013:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're still... newly born, after all.」

605:t_013:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Have you become a vessel that receives people's will...?」

605:t_013:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「One who connects people and turns that into power... Perhaps that is no longer... an individual being.」

605:t_013:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is this... the perfected $$ニュータイプ$$...!?」

605:t_013:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're so reckless...! Nobody wanted that kind of result! As long as there's a possibility, that's enough!」

605:t_013:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「Me, you, both of us! There must still be plenty we have to do in this world! I'll bring you back, no matter what!」

605:t_013:18.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll lend a hand, just a little. So that $$バナージ$$ wakes up.」

605:t_014:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The GN particles... are filling this region of space.」

605:t_014:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「With this, our hearts and $$バナージ$$ will be connected.」
